title: VPN will not connect from home
symptom: VPN fails to connect from the user's home
user_description: I'm working from home and the VPN just spins and then says it can't connect. I need my company files.

options.text: Give her a colleague's VPN login
options.why: Sharing logins destroys accountability and is a security risk.

options.text: Tell her to open every port on her home router
options.why: Weakens her home network and is almost never the fix. Test simple causes first.

options.text: Confirm her home internet works, check her credentials and multi-factor prompt, try another network such as a phone hotspot, and check whether the VPN works for other users
options.why: These steps separate her internet, her login, her home network and the VPN service itself. A hotspot test quickly shows whether her home network blocks the VPN.
Drastic. VPN problems are almost always credentials, network or the service, not the operating system.

hints: Does her home internet work at all?
Is it her login, her network, or the VPN service?
Is anyone else having the same problem?
real_world_tip: A phone hotspot test is very useful. If the VPN works there, the home router or provider is the cause.
